title: I built a SaaS in 48 hours using only AI — here's what happened

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I built a functional SaaS in 48 hours using only AI — no code, no delays, just speed and scalability.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: You didn’t build it — you generated a prototype. Real SaaS requires backend infrastructure, APIs, and security protocols.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I used AI to auto-generate RESTful APIs, deploy on AWS with Terraform, and integrate with Stripe — all in one go.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: That’s a demo, not a product. Real users demand reliability, which AI can’t guarantee without rigorous testing and maintenance.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The real world doesn’t run on hallucinations — your SaaS may look good, but it’s not built to last.
